archetype: Luxury Cinematic Dashboard (Elite Travel & Creative Mobility)

headings.usage: H1, H2, Hero statements, Destination Names, Editorial Cards. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.

body.usage: Dashboard data, lists, UI elements, button text. Clean and legible.

mono.usage: Travel codes, passport masked data, timezones, flight numbers, technical readiness scores.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5' or 'bg-[#0B1021]/60'. MANDATORY: 1px inner border using 'border-white/10' to separate it from the background.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient glows rather than drop shadows. E.g., 'box-shadow: 0 0 40px -10px rgba(139,92,246,0.3)' for the Translator.
visual_enhancers.borders: Minimal 1px borders using 'border-white/10'. Avoid heavy colored lines.
visual_enhancers.radii: Restrained curves. Use 'rounded-xl' or 'rounded-2xl' for cards, 'rounded-full' for pills/buttons.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the base background to remove digital flatness.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. 'p-6' to 'p-10' for dashboard cards. 'gap-6' to 'gap-8' for grids.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento-style grids. Use 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4' or 12-column spans. Maintain optical alignment.
layouts.mobile_first: Trip Mode must be heavily optimized for bottom-thumb navigation and extreme high-contrast readability.

motion.transitions: Smooth cinematic eases. Apply 'transition-all duration-500 ease-out' specifically to transforms, opacity, colors.
motion.hover_states: Slight lift ('-translate-y-1'), border color brightens, subtle inner glow activates. Text must remain WCAG AA compliant.
motion.microinteractions: Translator activation should have a ripple or glowing sound-wave effect. Destination cards gently scale up image ('scale-105') on hover.

image_urls.description: Cars driving through neon-lit intersection Tokyo
People watching band on the stage

components.Translator: SIGNATURE FEATURE. Must be visually distinct. Use an elevated glass card with an animated gradient border (cyan to magenta). Include a 'listening' or 'translating' sound wave micro-animation. Deep violet/cyan ambient glow. UI should reflect an intelligent, high-tech creative tool.
components.Destination_Card: Editorial style. Large image filling the card, dark gradient overlay from bottom, Playfair Display for city name. Subtle amber or cyan pill for 'Match Score' or 'Readiness'.
components.Passport_Profile: Masked data using monospace font. Tech-luxury feel. Clean 1px borders, subtle data charts using Axiom-style cyan/blue accents.
components.Trip_Mode: High urgency mobile view. Use dark canvas with electric cyan/amber for active steps. 'I Need Help' button in solid Amber/Red for immediate visibility without breaking the premium feel.
components.Sidebar_Nav: Elegant glassmorphic sidebar. Non-intrusive. Use lucide-react icons with 1.5 stroke width.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. strictly use Playfair Display (headings) and Manrope (body). Include Google Fonts links in HTML.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds for components overlaid on images. Use backdrop-blur with a tint.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and ambient drop-shadow glows.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-React. Do NOT use emojis.
Build Shadcn components directly into the UI directory if needed but heavily strip the 'Vercel-look' to match this Luxury Cinematic dark mode.
Translator needs massive emphasis: consider using framer-motion for a smooth entering sequence or pulse effect.
